description: Boots and simulates ESP32 firmware in a local emulator without hardware. Captures UART logs, FreeRTOS asserts, memory faults, and stop reason.

appBin.description: Direct path to the application binary (.bin).

board.description: Board model: S3 'atech14' (default), 'waveshare-lcd4b', 'waveshare-amoled18-v2', 'waveshare-cam'; C6 'waveshare-c6-lcd147'; ESP32 'ttgo-tdisplay', 'esp32dev-loopback'; 'none' for a bare module. Omit on the C3, which has no boards. See sim_list_boards.

bootloaderBin.description: Direct path to bootloader.bin (needed with appBin for a real ROM boot).

chip.description: Target chip family. Default is s3 (ESP32-S3).

console.description: Console source to capture (default: both = UART0 + USB-Serial/JTAG). Lines ESP-IDF mirrors on both consoles are shown once.

maxSeconds.description: Maximum emulated time in seconds (default: 10s). Emulation usually runs faster than real time.

projectDir.description: Path to the ESP-IDF project root or build folder. If omitted, uses current working directory.

ptableBin.description: Direct path to partition-table.bin (needed with appBin for a real ROM boot).

stopAfterExceptions.description: Stop after N CPU exceptions (unset by default). Counts every exception, including the window overflow/underflow ones Xtensa firmware takes constantly, so it is a debugging aid, not a crash detector. Panics are detected from the log regardless.

wifi.description: Attach a virtual access point with DHCP/DNS/NAT. Spec like 'ssid=demo,psk=secret' (keys: ssid, psk, chan, bssid), or a bare SSID for an open network. Station gets 10.0.2.15.

name: sim_run
